correctness.rationale: Han--Liu's 8 sqrt(delta) cotangent parallelogram estimate yields a matching bound on the von Neumann--Jordan constant; Passer's quantitative Jordan--von Neumann theorem then gives the stated Banach--Mazur estimate. Duality transfers the normed-space result, and Han--Liu's perturbation estimates together with elementary comparisons between parallelogram defect, von Neumann--Jordan constant, and Banach--Mazur distance prove sharpness of the square-root exponent.

originality.rationale: The BCD-to-parallelogram estimate and Passer's approximate Jordan--von Neumann theorem are prior art and are not claimed as new. Targeted literature and archive searches found no prior result converting almost BCD entropy error into Banach--Mazur Euclideanity of cotangent norms, nor the sharp square-root Banach--Mazur scale for the Han--Liu perturbation family.

value.rationale: The result upgrades an algebraic tangent defect to a standard affine-geometric stability statement, gives an explicit finite-error planar bound, and identifies the optimal error exponent through smooth non-Riemannian perturbations.
